title: Old-to-new statute mapping (Law Lens)
description: FROZEN 11:55. Law Lens flags only entries in this file. confirmed:false is never shown as current law.

old.description: The repealed or renumbered citation as it appears in city documents.

new_range.description: Current section or range. A range when no single section is confirmed.

confirmed.description: True only when a person opened the source and read it.
